description: waiveo/system is required at floor 2.0.0. Three install paths each try to land 1.0.0 -- a channel-pointer resolution, an explicit version pin (MKT-060a(c)), and a direct out-of-band artifact upload (MKT-094a) -- and all three are refused REQUIRED_PACK_FLOOR. MKT-050's anti-rollback alone would refuse only the first: it governs channel-pointer resolution, and MKT-060a(c)'s own enumeration of the checks a pinned reference remains subject to omits it, which is what keeps MKT-044's archived-version reinstall reachable. A fourth path installs the archived 2.0.0 by explicit pin and is ACCEPTED: the floor forbids going below 2.0.0, not reinstalling at or above it, so the archived-reinstall path a general never-install-older rule would have closed stays open.

expected.refusal_leaves_no_residue: no pack row change, no install record, no channel-mark advance, no generation bump
